Hi Aisha —

Great meeting yesterday. TerraScale and Redwood have strong overlap among mid-market infra teams; I think a co-hosted webinar ahead of CloudCon SF plus a shared booth could drive meaningful pipeline. Quick proposal to get us aligned: 

- Joint 45-minute webinar (30m content + 15m live Q&A) targeting SREs and platform leads, week of Aug 18.
- Shared 20x20 island booth at CloudCon SF with two demo stations and one joint lounge.
- Redwood asks for MDF contribution to cover shared booth build and event ads: $45k total (we're proposing 50/50 split).
- Resource split: 2 Redwood demoers on booth days + 1 webinar presenter; we ask TerraScale for the same.
- Deliverables: co-branded landing page, campaign emails (3), paid social spend, and webinar recording gated on HubSpot.

I've attached a booth layout and a draft MDF term sheet so we can iterate. Can you confirm whether TerraScale is open to a 50/50 MDF split or whether you need a different structure (e.g., 60/40)? Also please advise if your compliance team requires additional language on data handling for the webinar registration form.

If this looks good I'll loop in Laura for logistics and Marissa for creative ops.

Thanks —
Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear proposal — excited about the idea. High-level answers:

- Webinar week Aug 18 works for us; Jared will confirm exact days after we check exec availability.
- Booth looks good. We typically prefer a 60/40 MDF split in favor of the smaller partner when the partner is the event primary pipeline driver; since Redwood is driving the webinar content and we expect to share leads equally, would you consider 60 (TerraScale) / 40 (Redwood)? If not, we could do a performance-based rebate: 50/50 up front, with a 10% rebate to the lower-performing partner based on MQLs.
- Compliance: our privacy team needs a note in the registration flow that lists the two co-sponsors and includes a link to TerraScale's privacy policy. No additional constraints beyond that.

I'll let Jared and marketing weigh in on media spend and exact ad channels. If you can send a short SoW + MDF term sheet with sign-off fields we can route to procurement.

Best,
Aisha
